description:
Functional specifications covered / files: mix.exs, mix.lock; existing zaq-h2i.4 adapter declaration work and zaq-1lw.21 Telegram limitation
Audit selected SDK/provider operations against old f1767933/98cd98c8 pins and current Hex Jido 1.2.1/Mattermost 93025d5. Record exact available declaration/preparation/upload/send/edit contracts and compatible revisions. Reuse existing adapter follow-up rather than duplicate it. Do not copy old pins or invent support. Settle error-to-policy mapping when resolution fails; optional unresolved byte ceilings remain unknown, not unlimited facts.

Tests to add before implementation: Contract tests for real selected adapters, absent metadata, unsupported files, exact selected configuration and no-I/O declarations; retain current requirements tests.

Branches/paths validated: Contract tests for real selected adapters, absent metadata, unsupported files, exact selected configuration and no-I/O declarations; retain current requirements tests.

Action reuse assessment: Extend existing adapter contracts only if needed; existing capability_snapshot, FileSettings and TransportRequirements.resolve own declarations, normalization and derivation. External releases/pins remain explicit prerequisites; no publication authorized.

Consumers/execution: preserve existing Agent/Engine/Channel service boundaries; plan and prepared content never cross to Engine. Tool selection has no delivery side effect. Transport failures are reported without automatic retries.

Planning only in feat/delivery_plan; do not implement until the proposed migration is reviewed. Policies: AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/documentation.md; relevant service guides before affected work. Existing test behavior changes require specific approval; none granted by this plan. Mocking plan: keep internal boundaries real; isolate external transport/LLM APIs and inject runtime config without global mutations. Documentation: update module contracts and relevant owning service guide with implemented behavior, not duplicate policies. Validation follows authoritative workflow timing.
title: Verify adapter contracts and migration prerequisites
